decades, Dick had been calling dances in Connecticut.  He and his wife, Louise, finally
moved north to a beautiful retirement community called Riverwoods where he continued to
dance, maintaining a spry, humorous out look on life, till the end.  I wrote this tune
on a visit, after walking along the icy river and thinking how much we miss Dick.
